$description: Rhythm and position rules JSON Schema cannot express. Every rule has severity error|warn and named exceptions. Each rule id is implemented by a function of the same id in schema/semantic_validate.py (RULES dict); ids must stay in parity both ways. All rules were checked against the real node sequences in templates/templates.json (expanded at min and max repeat counts) when written; a template listed under exceptions genuinely violates the blanket rule. Rules take the PageSpec node order (shell.navbar first, shell.footer last).

notEvidenced.motionBudget: No real evidence of a per-page motion budget (the site has no cap on concurrent reveals/marquees), so no MOTION_BUDGET rule is defined. Per-node motion is checked by the schema (pattern const-locked per section, reducedMotionFallback required) and by the semantic validator instead.
notEvidenced.scrollStages: The site has no scroll-stage/pinned sections, so no NO_CONSECUTIVE_SCROLL_STAGES rule is defined.

rules.description: The PageSpec route must be one of the routes the declared template serves (templates.json routes).

The node list must match the declared template's real node list: same order, every required node present, no extra nodes; a node may appear more than once only when the template marks it repeatable, within its evidenced count {min,max}; repeated nodes of one (section, variant) key must be contiguous; a template node that fixes a variant fixes the PageSpec node's variant too.
Exactly one hero.main per page.
shell.navbar is the first node and shell.footer the last node, each exactly once.
hero.main immediately follows shell.navbar (contract mustFollowNav/mustBeFirst).
cta.pre-footer is present once and is the node immediately before shell.footer (it is the last page section on all 15 routes).
The same section id must not appear in two adjacent positions.

exceptions.reason: Every real page with callouts renders a contiguous run of 2-5 feature-callouts (src/pages/*.jsx).

rules.description: When faq.accordion is present, spacer.footer-gap is the very next node (13 of 13 real pages with a faq; on distribution the JSX order is products.highlight, faq, spacer, pre-footer).
When spacer.footer-gap is present it sits immediately before cta.pre-footer and immediately after faq.accordion.
Pages are expected to carry faq.accordion + spacer.footer-gap; a page without them is flagged (non-fatal).

exceptions.reason: Homepage has no faq or spacer (src/components/Main.jsx).
giftcloud goes carousel -> pre-footer with no faq/spacer.

rules.description: Where pricing.price-stack and products.highlight both occur, products.highlight (cross-sell variant) immediately follows the price stack (codapay, coda-links, webstore, distribution).

exceptions.reason: Homepage has no price stack; its catalog products.highlight is the second section, right after the hero.

rules.description: On product pages pricing.price-stack follows carousel.cards directly (4 of 4 real product pages that have one).

exceptions.reason: On /pricing/ the price stack is the second section, straight after the hero.

rules.description: A bridge.section, when present, sits immediately before the first callout.feature of the run (all 8 real occurrences).
All callout.feature nodes of a page form one contiguous run (never interleaved).

On routes that share a callout-run template the callout.feature count is fixed per route, as counted from each page's JSX (count of top-level feature-callout blocks): creator-economy 4, online-gaming 5, dating 3, digital-entertainment 3, esim 4, lms 4, merchant-of-record 5. Closes the looseness of the shared templates' 3-5 / 4-5 ranges.
(section, variant)-keyed: every callout.feature of a page carries the same variant (industry-icons-link, titled or dual-panel are per page).
callout.isolated, when present, immediately follows the last callout.feature (coda-links only).

Route-restricted sections appear only on their routes: awards.recognition and carousel.press on / only; tiles.page and comparison.integration on /product/codapay/ only; callout.isolated on /product/coda-links/ only; table.payment-method on /pricing/ only. Every other section must also be listed in its contract usedOn for the page route.
Section-contract constraints read from sections/*.json: onePerPage, maxPerPage, mustBeFirst, mustBeLast, noConsecutive, mustFollowNav, mustPrecedeFooter.
When a section contract's variant table names routes for the node's variant, the page route should be one of them; also the variant must be a key of the contract's variants.
